name: Identity & civil status
definition: Records that establish identity or significant personal-status facts.
applicability_when: Use for identity and civil-status records that actually apply to members of the household.
sensitivity_note: Identity documents can expose information that enables impersonation, account recovery, or other misuse if handled poorly.
examples: passport | birth certificate | citizenship or immigration document | marriage or divorce record | name-change record
review_triggers: document expiry or renewal | name or civil-status change | document loss, theft, replacement, or cancellation | citizenship or immigration status change

name: Home & property
definition: Records connected to owning, renting, inspecting, improving, repairing, or managing a home or other property.
applicability_when: Use when the household owns, rents, occupies, improves, or is otherwise responsible for a property.
sensitivity_note: Property records can reveal addresses, ownership, financing, access, condition, or security-related details.
examples: purchase document | lease | property assessment | inspection report | renovation record | permit | major property service history
review_triggers: move, purchase, sale, or new lease | renovation or permitted work | inspection or assessment | major repair or property-system replacement | ownership or occupancy change
related_categories: ohrt.insurance | ohrt.tax | ohrt.legal_estate | ohrt.financial | ohrt.household_assets_receipts_warranties | ohrt.household_services_utilities

name: Insurance
definition: Policies, renewals, coverage information, claims, proof of insurance, and insurer correspondence across household insurance needs.
applicability_when: Use for insurance products and claims that apply to the household, its people, property, vehicles, travel, or other insured interests.
sensitivity_note: Insurance records may contain identifying, financial, health, property, beneficiary, claim, or account information.
examples: home or tenant policy | vehicle policy | life policy | health or supplemental policy | travel policy | pet insurance policy | claim record | proof of insurance | renewal notice
review_triggers: policy renewal | coverage or deductible change | new or closed policy | claim opened or resolved | provider change | major household, property, vehicle, health, or travel change
related_categories: ohrt.home_property | ohrt.vehicles_transportation | ohrt.health_care | ohrt.travel | ohrt.financial | ohrt.pets

name: Tax
definition: Returns, assessments, slips, receipts, and supporting records retained or used for tax purposes.
applicability_when: Use for records whose primary household purpose is tax filing, support, assessment, payment, or correspondence.
sensitivity_note: Tax records commonly combine identity, income, account, address, dependant, and other sensitive personal information.
examples: tax return | notice of assessment or reassessment | income slip | deduction or credit support | tax payment record | tax correspondence
review_triggers: new tax year | return filed or amended | assessment or reassessment | supporting record corrected | tax dispute or review | retention requirement reached under the applicable authority

name: Legal & estate
definition: Legal instruments, court records, estate documents, representation documents, consent documents, and other records whose primary purpose is personal legal authority, status, representation, or estate matters rather than another household domain.
applicability_when: Use only for legal or estate records that actually apply to the people and circumstances in the household.
sensitivity_note: These records may affect legal authority, beneficiaries, dependants, property, finances, care, or other consequential rights and responsibilities.
examples: will | power of attorney | personal directive or representation document | court order | estate document | guardianship or custody order | consent document | separation agreement
review_triggers: new, amended, revoked, or replaced instrument | marriage, separation, birth, death, or dependant change | representative, executor, guardian, or beneficiary change | material property or financial change | move to a different legal jurisdiction
related_categories: ohrt.identity_civil_status | ohrt.financial | ohrt.home_property | ohrt.emergency_continuity | ohrt.education_children | ohrt.travel

name: Emergency & continuity
definition: Plans, contacts, accessible reference information, care instructions, and other material intended to help appropriate people act when normal household routines are disrupted.
applicability_when: Use for information deliberately prepared for emergency response, temporary incapacity, absence, or household continuity.
sensitivity_note: Emergency material may combine contact, health, identity, location, dependant, pet, access, or account-reference information and should expose only what is useful for the intended purpose.
examples: emergency plan | emergency contact list | care instruction | evacuation information | important-document location guide | accessible reference copy
review_triggers: move or address change | emergency contact change | health, medication, or care change | new or changed dependant | pet-care change | insurance or emergency-plan change | change in who is expected to help
related_categories: ohrt.identity_civil_status | ohrt.health_care | ohrt.insurance | ohrt.legal_estate | ohrt.education_children | ohrt.pets

name: Financial
definition: Banking, general borrowing, investments, financing, statements, and other household financial records that do not belong more naturally under a more specific family.
applicability_when: Use for financial accounts, obligations, assets, and transactions relevant to the household.
sensitivity_note: Financial records can contain account identifiers, balances, transactions, borrowing information, personal identifiers, and other high-impact information.
examples: bank statement | personal loan agreement | line of credit statement | investment statement | account summary | payment schedule
review_triggers: account opened or closed | loan or financing change | major payment or payoff | institution change | material investment or pension change | major household financial event

name: Vehicles & transportation
definition: Registration, purchase, financing, inspection, maintenance, service, and other records tied to vehicles or recurring transportation assets.
applicability_when: Use when the household owns, finances, leases, maintains, or is otherwise responsible for a vehicle or recurring transportation asset.
sensitivity_note: Vehicle records may contain registration, ownership, financing, address, location, identifier, or insurance information.
examples: vehicle registration | purchase record | financing record | inspection report | service invoice | maintenance history | tire or major-component record
review_triggers: purchase, lease, sale, or disposal | registration or inspection renewal | service or major repair | accident or claim | financing change or payoff | major component or ownership change

name: Health & care
definition: Records used to understand, document, or coordinate health, medication, treatment, providers, and care.
applicability_when: Use for health and care information that the household legitimately maintains or needs to coordinate.
sensitivity_note: Health and care information is deeply personal and may be subject to additional legal or professional handling requirements depending on context and jurisdiction.
examples: medication list | vaccination record | care plan or instruction | treatment or test summary | dental record | vision record | provider information | medical equipment information
review_triggers: medication change | diagnosis or treatment change | provider or care-team change | new health or care record | vaccination update | care arrangement or medical-equipment change

name: Household assets, receipts & warranties
definition: Purchase, ownership, warranty, manual, serial-number, repair, and supporting evidence connected to significant household belongings and equipment.
applicability_when: Use for belongings or equipment where purchase, ownership, operation, service, warranty, or replacement information is worth retaining.
sensitivity_note: Many asset records are low-risk, but ownership evidence, serial numbers, addresses, purchase values, account details, or security-related equipment can increase sensitivity.
examples: purchase receipt | warranty | owner manual | serial-number photo | product registration | repair record | ownership photograph | replacement record
review_triggers: new purchase | warranty registration or expiry | repair or replacement | sale, donation, loss, or disposal | serial number or ownership evidence captured | insurance claim or inventory update

name: Education & children
definition: Records connected to education, training, childcare, children's activities, enrolment, permission, progress, and related learning or dependant administration.
applicability_when: Use for education or training records that household members keep, and for child or dependant records whose primary purpose is school, childcare, activities, or related administration.
sensitivity_note: Education records may contain identity, grades, credentials, contact, schedule, accommodation, or other personal information. Records involving children or dependants can add custody, pickup, location, or care details.
examples: school or post-secondary enrolment record | report card or transcript | diploma or certificate | permission form | childcare information | activity registration | school notice | pickup or release instruction
review_triggers: new school, course, training, childcare, or program | new academic or activity period | completion, graduation, or credential issue | contact or pickup arrangement change | custody or guardian change | health or accommodation change | record loses practical relevance

name: Employment & income
definition: Employment, compensation, benefits, pension, credential, and other records primarily connected to work and household income.
applicability_when: Use for employment, contracting, benefits, pension, credential, or income records that apply to household members.
sensitivity_note: Employment and income records can expose compensation, identifiers, benefits, banking, tax, health, or other personal information.
examples: employment agreement | pay statement | employment benefits enrollment or plan summary | pension record | professional credential | employment confirmation | compensation change record
review_triggers: new job or contract | compensation or benefits change | employment ends | pension or retirement change | credential issue, renewal, or expiry | material income change

name: Pets
definition: Veterinary, vaccination, registration, medication, adoption, licence, and care records associated with household animals.
applicability_when: Use where the household has animals whose health, ownership, care, registration, or practical care information is worth maintaining.
sensitivity_note: Pet records are often low-risk, but owner contact details, addresses, payment information, access arrangements, or care information can increase sensitivity.
examples: veterinary record | vaccination record | prescription | licence | adoption record | microchip information | care instruction | boarding or caregiver record
review_triggers: adoption or ownership change | veterinarian change | medication or care change | vaccination or licence update | pet lost, rehomed, or deceased

name: Travel
definition: Trip-specific bookings, visas, itineraries, confirmations, rentals, and supporting travel information.
applicability_when: Use for information whose primary purpose is a specific trip or travel arrangement.
sensitivity_note: Travel records can reveal identity details, travel dates, locations, booking references, contact information, payment details, and periods when a home may be unoccupied.
examples: flight or rail booking | hotel confirmation | visa | itinerary | rental agreement | tour or activity confirmation | refund or cancellation record
review_triggers: booking or itinerary change | visa or entry-document change | trip cancelled or completed | claim, refund, or dispute | travel document expires

name: Household services & utilities
definition: Utility, communications, security, and recurring home-service records connected to operating a household or property.
applicability_when: Use for recurring utility, communications, security, or home-service relationships that apply to the household.
sensitivity_note: Service records can reveal address, account, contact, usage, access, security-system, payment, or property information.
examples: electricity bill | gas bill | water account | internet or mobile agreement | security-system record | installation record | recurring service agreement | service correspondence
review_triggers: move | provider or plan change | new installation | major service or repair | account ownership change | service cancellation or closure
